title: Tech Note: 4D 2004 Product Registration
author: Tom Fitch, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Online, offline, and emergency activation modes

historical_commentary.text: This note is purely an administrative/support guide to the 4D 2004 product activation workflow (online, offline, and emergency modes, product numbers, and the Licenses folder), with no code or lasting technical concept beyond general activation UX. It is entirely obsolete: the specific 4D 2004 registration UI, product number formats, and register.4d.com online activation flow described no longer exist, having been replaced multiple times by later 4D licensing systems.
related_updates: 4D's licensing and activation system has been redesigned multiple times since 4D 2004, including changes tied to 4D v11, v13, and later cloud-based license management
The register.4d.com portal and 4D 2004-era product number formats described in this note are no longer in use
